rows.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `srv_answer` (
  `survey_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `qcode` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `item_id` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'As srv_result. 0 with option_id 0 = base row: this respondent answered the multi question',
  `option_id` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'As srv_result: the answer for single choice, 0 for a multi item chosen',
  `respondent_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `age_band` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `generation` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `income_band` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `census_region` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `urbanicity` varchar(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`survey_id`,`qcode`,`item_id`,`option_id`,`respondent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_srv_answer_wave` FOREIGN KEY (`survey_id`) REFERENCES `srv_wave` (`survey_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Serving layer: qualified answers with every cut, for combined filters; multi items only when chosen'

CREATE TABLE `cip_agg_cell` (
  `cell_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `survey_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `cell_key` varchar(200) NOT NULL COMMENT 'question:item:option:cohort:scheme:dim:value',
  `question_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `item_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `option_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `concept_option_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `cohort_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'NULL = all qualified respondents',
  `scheme_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'NULL = unweighted',
  `dim` varchar(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'total, gender, age_band, …',
  `dim_value` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `n` int NOT NULL,
  `base_n` int NOT NULL,
  `n_weighted` decimal(14,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `base_weighted` decimal(14,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sum_age_mid` decimal(14,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sum_income_mid_k` decimal(16,4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `built_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `map_key` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL,
  `n_age_mid` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `n_income_mid` int DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`cell_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_agg_cell` (`survey_id`,`cell_key`),
  KEY `ix_agg_concept` (`concept_option_id`,`cohort_id`,`dim`,`survey_id`),
  KEY `ix_agg_question` (`survey_id`,`question_id`,`dim`),
  KEY `fk_agg_question` (`question_id`),
  KEY `ix_agg_map` (`survey_id`,`map_key`,`cohort_id`,`dim`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_agg_question` FOREIGN KEY (`question_id`) REFERENCES `cip_question` (`question_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_agg_survey` FOREIGN KEY (`survey_id`) REFERENCES `cip_survey` (`survey_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5688924 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Pre-computed counts per wave x answer x cut x cohort.'

CREATE TABLE `cip_answer` (
  `answer_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `respondent_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `survey_id` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'denormalised for filter speed',
  `field_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `value_code` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '0/1, 1-5, 1-54',
  `value_label` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'resolved label, denormalised for display',
  `value_number` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'open numeric',
  `value_text` text COMMENT 'open-ended verbatim',
  PRIMARY KEY (`answer_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_answer` (`respondent_id`,`field_id`),
  KEY `fk_answer_field` (`field_id`),
  KEY `ix_answer_cover` (`survey_id`,`field_id`,`value_code`,`respondent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_answer_field` FOREIGN KEY (`field_id`) REFERENCES `cip_field` (`field_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_answer_respondent` FOREIGN KEY (`respondent_id`) REFERENCES `cip_respondent` (`respondent_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=59220635 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Every answer, long format. ~151k rows per wave.'

CREATE TABLE `srv_result` (
  `survey_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `qcode` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `dim` varchar(30) NOT NULL COMMENT 'total, gender, age_band, generation, income_band, census_region, urbanicity',
  `dim_value` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `item_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0 for single-choice questions',
  `option_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0 for multi-choice items',
  `question_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `qtype` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `item_label` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `option_code` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `option_label` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `concept_option_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Harmonised answer: the same answer across waves, for trends',
  `n` int NOT NULL,
  `base_n` int NOT NULL,
  `pct` decimal(6,3) NOT NULL,
  `prior_pct` decimal(6,3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `prior_base_n` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `ly_pct` decimal(6,3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ly_base_n` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `flags` set('small_base','base_changed_prior','base_changed_ly','wording_changed_prior','wording_changed_ly','sig_prior','sig_ly') NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`survey_id`,`qcode`,`dim`,`dim_value`,`item_id`,`option_id`),
  KEY `ix_srv_concept` (`concept_option_id`,`dim`,`dim_value`,`survey_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_srv_result_wave` FOREIGN KEY (`survey_id`) REFERENCES `srv_wave` (`survey_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Serving layer: finished percentages with comparisons, one PK range per screen widget'

CREATE TABLE `srv_wave` (
  `survey_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `survey_family` varchar(80) NOT NULL,
  `study_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `wave_date` date NOT NULL,
  `qualified_n` int NOT NULL,
  `prior_survey_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Previous verified wave of the same tracker family (within 14 days)',
  `ly_survey_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Same family, same calendar week last year (wave_date - 364 days, ±3)',
  `ly_status` enum('loaded','not_loaded','none') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' COMMENT 'not_loaded: that week exists in Forsta but was never loaded (e.g. hibernated)',
  `rows_built` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `built_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `in_field` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`survey_id`),
  KEY `ix_srv_wave_family` (`survey_family`,`wave_date`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_srv_wave_survey` FOREIGN KEY (`survey_id`) REFERENCES `cip_survey` (`survey_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Serving layer: one row per verified wave'
